title: chore(deps): build @objectstack/* from objectstack main 2ec6827962 and follow its contract (objectui#12971)
body:
Fixes #12971

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

**Scope:** move `.objectstack-sha` from `2c9bf9430a` (the `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.3 release commit) to objectstack `main` `f4755a68a797`. Then follow every contract change between the two that turns something red here, with no tolerant fallback. The only exemptions are the bookings the seat ruled on objectui#12971 (record 6267645900, decisions D1 to D4).

The held cards' feature work is not done here: objectui#12932, objectui#12931, objectui#12929, objectui#12484 and objectui#13015. This PR makes their commits available.

The Undo snapshot and the renderers' row `patch` forwarding are objectui#13022's (PR #13033). That PR landed first by decision D3 and was merged into this branch.

**Status: CI is green on head `2abf91da`** (33 success, 3 skipped; listed below). This body was refreshed once through the relay. It replaces the body written at `9310c0ea`.

## The pin

- `f4755a68a797d5a000cb8bd1c942cb2a9862108e` was the newest objectstack `main` commit green at the move: 150 check-runs completed, none failed.
- The first move went to `2ec6827962`, whose packages read `18.0.0-next.4`. objectstack never published or tagged next.4, so `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` had no published version to pair with. `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` holds that file equal to the lockfile's spec version.
  - objectstack then released `18.0.0-next.5` at `820fd5aef0`. `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh` moved the pin again, to `f4755a68a7`, which is past that release and reads next.5.
  - `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION=18.0.0-next.5` now resolves the tag `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5`, and Live E2E passes on it.
- Ancestry: `git merge-base --is-ancestor SHA f4755a68a7` exits 0 for all of these:
  - `586705d85d`, `1e001c7df`, `e15897c0f1`, `ef65646843` and `adb7910f81`;
  - `69f342b924`, `3a734e0888` and `820fd5aef0`;
  - the old pin `2c9bf9430a` (201 commits apart).
  - On the same shallow checkout, `5b14b7f3ad` (newer than the pin) exits 1 as the negative control.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged: the seven packages declare the same dependency names.
- After merging `main`, which brought objectui#13008's committed manifests, `.objectstack-pin/*/package.json` was rewritten by `objectstack-pin.mjs build --write-manifests`. Only the packed versions move.

## Reds at the new pin, and what this PR does

|---|---|---|
| parity: `action:button` / `action:icon` publish `patch` | `69f342b924`, a row's own `patch` is a tombstone | the inputs blocks stop publishing it. Both are pinned by name as harvested tombstones; the `patch` member pin and the published-key list entry go |
| parity: carried 60 to 61, judged 40 to 41 | `194a42d1f7`, `list-view` gains a `ComponentPropsMap` row | `list-view` joins the covered set |
| parity: `list-view` publishes 6 of 44 live keys, 6 member pins owed | `194a42d1f7` | **D1 = A**: 38 keys and 6 member pins booked OWED to objectui#13047 under objectui#11111 decision 3 = B, expiry 2026-11-18. The caps rise to exactly those (unpublishedKeys 38, memberPins 6, member-pin ceiling 6). Nothing declared |
| parity: `emptyState` unpublished on `record:details` / `record:highlights` / `record:quick_actions` | `586705d85d` | **D2 = A**: three `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entries owned by objectui#12932 (the objectui#12370 precedent) |

Two describe blocks compare the spec's own issue, with controls |
| `passing-keys-arms-11440`, `validate-passing-keys-11440` | `3a734e0888` | `width: 'large'` removed from the `main` region |
| `imported-defaults-8317` | the two checks | registered as refinement exceptions |
| `ObjectTree.schemaTyped-8655` | `194a42d1f7` | `list-view` added to the `navigation` / `tree` rows |

| `navigation-spec-parity`, `nav-target.navEntryTypes-11790` | `26501ae24f` (objectstack#24332), nav-item base `dataSource` | mirrored by reference in `NavigationItemSchema` (it stripped the key before) and the `NavigationItem` type; `NAV_ENTRY_BASE_KEYS` keeps it on a retype |
| `ci-cd-pipeline-doc` (live-e2e pin) | the bump | `backend.env` set to `18.0.0-next.5` (see the pin section) |
| `check:installed-pin-claims` (25 files) | the bump | each sentence's fact re-measured (node probe, identical at both new pins) and restamped `18.0.0-next.5`. Two fixture lines in `check-lockfile-integrity.mjs` ledgered `historical` |
| Type Check: `action-button-undoable-11168` TS2353 | `69f342b924` | **D3 = A**: objectui#13022 (PR #13033) landed first and rewrote the test. Merged here; the inputs blocks (this PR) and the forwarding lines (#13033) both kept |

## Clause-② (D4 = B): yes, both directions

Narrowings, refused with the spec's own message on `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (`objectui validate`):

- `main` region `width: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'` on a `page` node or a page-kind node, at the region's `width`: "Region `main` is refused with `width: 'large'` (since @objectstack/spec 18): a `main` region takes only `width: 'full'`."
- a `record` binding on a page-kind node, at `record`, for example: "`record` binds the row of an `app` page, and this page is `type: 'home'`, which has no row to bind."
- the `patch` input on `action:button` / `action:icon` is no longer published.

Widenings, the spec's keys by reference, which the strict face refused as undeclared before:

- `emptyState` on the three bound record blocks. The renderer half is objectui#12932.
- `record` on a `page` node, for any `pageType`. The renderer half is objectui#12931.
- `dataSource` on navigation entries. The spec marks it planned.

The changeset (`.changeset/12971-objectstack-pin-main.md`, `minor`) carries the same line and both lists.

## Ablation

`checkPageMainRegionWidth` was detached at both sites with `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor x2 to x0, blob `1e46e7fa45cd` to `ed50b46f958d`.

- Result: `Tests 3 failed | 97 passed`. The three failures are exactly the `main`-width refusal rows; the controls stayed green.
- Expected direction: red. Observed: red.
- Restore: blob back to the HEAD blob `1e46e7fa45cd`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification at head `2abf91da`

- CI, all success: Build & E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate, Lint, Live E2E (informational), Repo Gates, Test, Test shards 1 to 16, Test (dist pins), Type Check, label.
- CI skipped: the two coverage jobs and dependabot.
- Local: `pnpm type-check --concurrency=2 --continue` gives `Tasks: 81 successful, 81 total`.
- Local targeted run after the merge, 1203 of 1203 tests:
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/`;
  - `ActionRunner.declaredPatch-13022`;
  - `registry-inputs-spec-parity`;
  - `check-action-forward-parity` (test and gate);
  - `spec-object-refinements-7715`;
  - `imported-defaults-8317`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.
- `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:installed-pin-claims` (OK) and `check:lockfile-integrity` (clean) all exit 0. `check:lockfile-dedupe` reads deduped.

## Acceptance notes

- Filed from this work: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24534. objectui's `NavigationItemSchema` accepts `visible: 'data.x'` without `dataSource`, which the spec refuses. The spec's check is not exported, so it cannot be attached here yet.
- `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` and `page-single-h1.test.tsx` still author `width: 'large'` on `main`. Nothing validates them.
- The installed-pin-claims gate and the live-e2e pin compare version strings, not commits.
